sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ExecutorService object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: Owned fixture pool is unconditionally shut down and awaited for at most ten seconds in finally before its owned registry closes. Implicit close waits without that bound.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: The site applies to isolated unit-owned finite test threads, lifetime and results are guarded and application/service threads are never created.

sourceAnchors.reason: This JUnit assertion explicitly specifies the generated Snapshot equality contract for a null input. Passing null is necessary to distinguish value equality from instance identity.
